title: 8.40. Cittasahabhūduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nacittasahabhuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nacittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā nava …pe… purejāte āsevane pañca …pe… avigate nava.
